test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six frogs, P, Q, R, S, T and U, were sitting around a circular pond, facing the centre. T was second to the left of S. P was second to the right of U. P is not seated three places to the right of Q. There are exactly two frogs between Q and S. Which frog was sitting to the immediate right of P?
solution:
Given: Six frogs, P, Q, R, S, T and U, were sitting around a circular pond, facing the centre.

1) T was second to the left of S.

2) There are exactly two frogs between Q and S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9987efbe5343bcb7f3a49851fc9c8d5da7fd18bb6791cc4b7896d976563fc39.png] 

3) P was second to the right of U.

4) P is not seated three places to the right of Q.

And, frog R will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b42d6e09eb6301801d539082ff0619e5995084f5048ffb8f46d4e06426dbd93.png] 

Here, frog 'R' was sitting to the immediate right of P.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
